transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 796 Thistlecroft Drive?

Yes, this is 796 Thistlecroft Drive.  
We’re safe, just two people here.
Thank you for confirming your address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Two people here. No one can’t come to the phone.

Thank you for letting us know about the people here. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave alone. No wheelchairs or medical needs here.
Got it, no one here can’t leave alone or has special needs. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. Just us two, safe here.
If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No, I don’t have a truck, boat, or free seats. I’m safe right now.
Thank you for sharing your current situation. Let me read that back: 2 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes. Just us two. No water in yet.
Got it. Staying put for now. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
